text:
tara: quick sync — we need a plan for persisting the mapping between external billing keys and trace tenant ids so we can backfill cost attribution after id rotation.

kevin: quick q — why can't we just join by request_id in query time?

tara: because request_id often missing; some pipelines drop it. We need a durable map so queries can resolve historical traces to tenants even after sampling/enrichment.

morgan: two patterns: 1) append breadcrumb to traces at ingest (tiny kvs) 2) maintain a separate key-value store (tenant_map) that's updated from auth service and enrichers.

lina: tradeoffs: (1) increases trace envelope size -> storage/egress cost, (2) separate store -> join at query time but simpler to rotate keys and TTL management.

sam: also consider KMS rotation: if tenant identifiers are encrypted, we need key-rotation-safe lookups (decrypt-on-write vs decrypt-on-read tradeoffs).

tara: proposal: keep breadcrumb in trace header only for first-hop edges (edge gateways), push tenant_map to a compact materialized view in obs-store with TTL 90d, expose read-optimized API for joins and bulk backfills.

kevin: how do we handle partial writes? idempotency concerns when the same mapping is written by multiple regions.

morgan: write-side dedupe via (external_key, source, version) CAS. fallback: accept eventual consistency window <= 5m and surface a "resolved_at" timestamp.

lina: need migration plan for existing 12 months of traces: backfill job that replays edge logs, populates tenant_map, and emits reconciliation metrics.

tara: rollout plan: canary region -> 5% traffic with breadcrumb enabled -> run backfill -> validate sample queries and error budget.

sam: sample query snippet:

```sql
-- resolve tenant for trace
SELECT t.tenant_id, tr.*
FROM traces tr
LEFT JOIN tenant_map t
  ON tr.edge_key = t.external_key
WHERE tr.ts >= '2025-01-01'
```

morgan: perf note: tenant_map should be sharded by external_key hash and served with an LRU cache in the query fleet. Ensure cold misses are batched.

kevin: SLA ask: join latency < 15ms p95 for ad-hoc queries. If join misses, fallback to heuristic (ip->tenant guess) and tag as 'heuristic_resolved' so downstream doesn't silently charge incorrectly.

lina: privacy/regulatory: storing external_key needs retention & access controls — legal/infosec signoff required for 90d TTL and read-API.

ops-bot: deploy plan created at #deployments/7123456820 :hourglass: 

ingest-bot: indexer job scheduled -> job_id=ix-20250203-01 (backfill will stream to tenant_map)

sam: ops/console note: add "resolved_by" column and a flag for 'backfilled' vs 'live' in telemetry UI; show TTL and last_updated.

tara: agreed. I'll draft a short RFC with the above plus proto for tenant_map, migration steps, metrics, and canary checklist.

kevin: sgtm. can we add metrics: map_hits, map_misses, backfill_throughput, reconcile_errors?

morgan: yes — + alert if map_miss_rate > 5% sustained for 24h or backfill lag > 6h.

lina: also add audit log for reads of tenant_map for compliance.

tara: cool — I'll open RFC and assign owners. thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: one last thing — make sure query planner can choose materialized join vs cached lookup depending on query shape.

tara: noted, will include decision matrix in RFC.
